title: Implement write-with-diff and rollback handle flow
purpose: Ensure file-changing operations are inspectable and reversible before they can touch the real target.
scope: Write changes in a shadow copy, overlay, or isolated workspace first.
Generate diff with base hash, target path, proposed content hash, and rollback metadata.
Require approval before commit for system-sensitive paths.
Persist rollback handles and verify the post-commit state.
acceptance_criteria: No write-with-diff action mutates the target before diff review.
Commit writes EffectPrepared before mutation and CommitSealed after verification.
Rollback can restore the previous content for supported file changes.
Base hash mismatch blocks stale writes.
verification: Run rollback test after simulated failed verification.

completed_evidence.write_diff_demo: shadow diff preserved target before commit, commit sealed verified write, rollback restored previous content.

risk_notes: Rollback for packages and services is not equivalent to file rollback; keep MVP flow scoped to supported file changes.
